description: India's largest private-sector bank by assets (merged with parent HDFC Ltd in July 2023); retail, wholesale and treasury banking. No promoter after the merger.
India's second-largest private-sector bank; retail, SME and corporate banking, with group companies in life and general insurance, asset management and securities. No promoter.
India's second-largest IT services company: consulting, technology, outsourcing and digital services (cloud, AI and data, digital engineering, cybersecurity).
India's largest private-sector conglomerate: oil-to-chemicals, retail (Reliance Retail), digital and telecom (Jio Platforms, 66.43% stake), media and new energy. Promoted by the Ambani family (~50%).
Flagship IT services, consulting and business solutions company of the Tata group; offers consulting-led, AI-enabled business, technology and engineering services.
